collection_policy: frozen deterministic base through warmup, no actor/critic/alpha updates; at most 4000 steps per terrain so warmup cannot finish
finish: After two attempted trials, lock evaluation through ledger API without running evaluation or retention; repeated lock must not add cost. Do not resume adaptation.
failure_policy: Retain failures and uncertain costs; no replacement starts. Abort on incomplete worker outcome and report unavailable boundary coverage.
audit: Compare per-step committed counts, reward/endings/request/base actions, float16 replay fields, optimizer states and cumulative replay across checkpoints. Expected natural task terminals may enter replay; never override safety eligibility.
